capabilities: Show a customizable Today page of cards
Plan tasks on a day, week or month board
Organize projects and areas with their own task pages
Read tasks from checkboxes, task notes, Todoist, ClickUp or Things 3
Replace the file list with a folder sidebar
disambiguation: Not a worldbuilding or life-simulation tool; it is a daily planner built from notes in your vault.
extras: No account, payment or tracking; API tokens, the Stormglass key and calendar links are kept in each device's local storage and are not synced or backed up. A free companion plugin, LifeWorld Capture, adds menu-bar capture on computers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan a day or week and track projects and tasks together, so planning is spread across daily notes, checkboxes and separate apps.

relations.evidence: If the TaskNotes plugin is installed, you can let it do the writing instead.
Checkboxes in any note, including the Tasks plugin's date and priority signs.
Todoist or ClickUp, with your own API token.
If you pick Dateline for the Month calendar (macOS desktop only), LifeWorld asks the Dateline app

summary: Planner that adds a Today page, a day/week/month Planner, project and area pages, and a folder sidebar, with tasks kept as plain Markdown notes.
